about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: AI Passion, Engineering Vision
about.bio: I'm a 4th-year Computer Engineering student at İnönü University, specializing in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning since 2022. I build end-to-end intelligent systems using Python, TensorFlow, and Scikit-learn, with experience spanning computer vision, NLP, and reinforcement learning. I focus on turning complex theoretical concepts into practical, reliable, production-ready solutions.

aliagaAI.title: AliağaAI - Smart City Assistant
aliagaAI.tagline: An AI-powered smart city assistant and urban guide built with React Native and a multi-stage RAG FastAPI backend with pgvector, delivering verified responses.
aliagaAI.overview: Built to overcome the limitations and advertising bias of standard search engines by leveraging verified municipal and local knowledge with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation).
features: Intelligent agentic query router
Hybrid semantic vector search with pgvector
Verified municipal and public knowledge base
Modern mobile user experience in React Native

aiDreamInterpreter.title: AI Dream Interpreter
aiDreamInterpreter.tagline: Map your subconscious. An AI-powered dream tracking and psychological analysis platform grounded in Jungian and Freudian frameworks.
aiDreamInterpreter.overview: A secure mobile platform allowing users to log dreams and analyze symbolic meanings and emotional patterns using Google Gemini models.
features: Jungian and Freudian symbolic dream interpretation
Emotional tone and recurring motif tracker
Secure and encrypted user data handling
Minimalist dark mode mobile interface

kayipQR.title: KayıpQR - Smart QR Tag Platform
kayipQR.tagline: Get your lost items back without sharing your phone number. Customizable QR labels with anonymous messaging.
kayipQR.overview: An end-to-end platform enabling finders to contact item owners anonymously through disposable chat sessions without exposing phone numbers or emails.
features: Interactive QR design studio with custom themes
Anonymous communication without phone exchange
Item lifecycle states (Safe, Lost, Returned)
A4 sheet layout and PDF/SVG export ready for printing

weDo.title: WeDo - Shared Idea & Decision App
weDo.tagline: Save what inspires you. Decide together. Make it happen. A collaborative mobile planning app for couples and friend groups.
weDo.overview: Enables friends and partners to collect ideas, spots, and links from across the web into shared lists and make collective decisions.
features: Shared boards with real-time sync across devices
Quick link and visual capture integration
Collaborative polling and decision mechanisms
Clean Expo SDK 54 and FastAPI Python 3.13 stack

visualAI.title: Real-Time Visual Understanding
visualAI.tagline: Real-time webcam image analysis producing natural language descriptions using 100% local multimodal Ollama LLaVA AI.
visualAI.overview: A privacy-first vision AI system running entirely on local GPU without sending any data to external cloud services.
features: 100% Local AI: No internet required and zero data leakage
Low-latency camera streaming over WebSockets
Ollama and LLaVA-7B multimodal deep learning model
Unlimited, unthrottled real-time analysis

thinking.title: My Problem-Solving Philosophy
thinking.subtitle: Principles I follow when transforming complex problems into simple solutions.
thinking.quote: A good engineer never starts coding without understanding the problem first.

firstPrinciples.title: Understand First, Solve Later
firstPrinciples.description: I never start coding without fully understanding the problem. I analyze requirements, consider edge cases, then move to implementation.

outcome.title: Simplicity First
outcome.description: The best code is the least complex code. I avoid premature optimization and focus on readable, maintainable solutions.

iterations.title: Bugs = Learning
iterations.description: Every bug is an opportunity to understand how the system works. Instead of quick fixes, I investigate the root cause.

systems.title: Data-Driven Thinking
systems.description: I base decisions on data, not intuition. I measure model performance with metrics and validate with A/B testing.

debugging.title: Documentation Culture
debugging.description: Half of software is code, the other half is documentation. I leave explanatory notes even for my future self.

curiosity.title: Continuous Learning
curiosity.description: Technology constantly evolves. I try to learn something new every day and experiment to stay current.
